typed_edge_walks.png.alt: A composable walk goes from packet zero through one and two to three; a mismatched intermediate packet makes a product zero.

transport_vs_connection.png.alt: Two directed triangles distinguish canonical transport, whose loop is identity, from a chosen connection, whose holonomy changes by conjugation.

holonomy_obstruction_blocks.png.alt: A four-by-four obstruction grid highlights the possible transfer from input packet three to output packet one.

packet_jet_worked_example.png.alt: At the origin, the two output Hessians of F(x,y)=(x+xy,y+x squared) are [zero, one; one, zero] and [two, zero; zero, zero].

correction_cokernel_plane.png.alt: The defect (two, three) splits into a horizontal correctable part (two, zero) and a remaining vertical representative (zero, three).

rotating_projector_transport.png.alt: A line rotates counterclockwise by pi over three while its perpendicular complement follows; meshes of two, four and eight steps give the same exact rotation.
